text:
maria: quick sync — finalizing UX for SLA-driven auto-fallback. goal: make decisions auditable and actionable without clutter. thinking: an "SLA Ledger" row per firing + expandable details.

simon: +1. minimal audit fields: signal_type, window, value, threshold, policy_id, decision, target_model, operator_override_id.

lee: don't forget policy_version and the actual evaluated expression. replay needs that.

jules: UX trade: show raw metric stream inline or link out? inline sparks faster triage, but we should collapse by default.

maria: plan: ledger table with columns: ts | signal | value | decision | policy | pattern | quick-link. Expand opens a flyout with sparkline, last 5 firings, evaluated expression, route context.

ops-bot: policy-service:autofallback v2.4 deployed to canary (region-us-west) at 4876549892.

simon: proposal for ledger row (stringified example):
```
ts=4876549892,policy=autofallback-v2.4,signal=p95_latency,window=60s,value=1800ms,threshold=1500ms,decision=fallback,target=gptq-8k-quant,pattern=sustained,route=chat_default,customer=tier-2
```

lee: add route_id and pinned_model fields so we know why the fallback chose X. also include firing_pattern enum {spike,sustained,hysteresis}.

jules: operator overrides: must be immutable with reason + optional ttl. show them inline and in exports. no silent overrides.

maria: retention q: ledger rows vs raw traces. suggestion: ledger rows small, keep 180d. raw metric traces keep 30d. UI should show retention label and an export button for audits.

simon: add incident_link if fallback correlated with an incident. also store deploy_hash so correlating with rollouts is easy.

ops-bot: alert: cluster-us-west p95 latency > 1500ms at 4876549922 (autofallback triggered).

jules: UI detail: make a "why-it-fired" flyout showing: evaluated expression, recent metric series, firing pattern explanation, and last operator action. helpful when it's a one-off spike.

lee: filter affordances: by policy_id, signal, route, customer_tier, decision, operator. also timeline sync with deploys/scale events.

maria: safety: operator override UI should warn if TTL > 24h and require justification. Also surface a pre-commit lint if override removes fallback from high-severity policies.

simon: storage/infra TODOs: sample ledger throughput estimate from telemetry, index keys for fast queries, and export API for auditors. I'll draft schema + sample SQL.

jules: I'll draft retention policy and export CSV/JSON shape. will sketch UI in figma and link.

maria: action list: simon -> ledger schema + indexing; lee -> flyout mock + filters; jules -> retention + export API; infra -> storage cost. reconvene tomorrow 10am.

ops-bot: thread pinned to eng-platform by ops-bot.
